en.headline: Man arrested after cleaver attack on colleague at Fan Kam Road village house
en.dek: Police detained a 48-year-old man on Thursday afternoon after he allegedly attacked a co-worker with a cleaver during an argument at staff quarters in Yuen Long.
body: A 48-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of criminal intimidation and assault occasioning actual bodily harm after an alleged cleaver attack on a colleague at a village house on Fan Kam Road on Thursday afternoon.

Police received a report around 2pm from a 45-year-old man surnamed Sze. He told officers he had argued with a man surnamed Lee, also in his forties, over a minor matter at the premises, which sources said are used as staff quarters. During the dispute Lee allegedly threatened him and then struck him with a cleaver.

Sze suffered neck injuries but remained conscious and was taken to North District Hospital for treatment. Officers recovered a cleaver about 20 centimetres long at the scene. Lee was arrested and is being detained for investigation.
The case has been passed to the Yuen Long district crime investigation team. Police are examining the circumstances of the argument between the two colleagues.

zh.headline: 粉錦路村屋同事爭執 48歲男持菜刀斬傷被捕
zh.dek: 周四下午約兩時，元朗粉錦路一間村屋內兩名同事因琐事爭執，一名48歲男子涉嫌持菜刀襲擊45歲同事，已被警方拘捕。
body: 警方周四下午在元朗粉錦路一間村屋拘捕一名48歲男子，涉嫌刑事恐嚇及襲擊致造成實際身體傷害。
約下午兩時，警方接獲45歲姓施男子報案，指他與一名姓李的48歲男子在屋內因琐事發生爭執。據了解，該處用作員工宿舍，兩人是同事。爭執期間，李涉嫌口頭恐嚇後持菜刀襲擊施。
施頸部受傷，但仍清醒，被送往北區醫院治理。警員在現場檢獲一把長約20厘米的菜刀。李已被拘捕，正被扣留調查。
案件已交由元朗警區刑事調查隊跟進，繼續了解兩名同事爭執的經過。
